$comment: Compiled from docs/DESIGN.md section 2.5. Account-first routing: leads group to accounts by registrable domain BEFORE routing; the account routes, leads inherit. route.ts executes this file — change routing by editing config, never code.

ownership.rule: an OWNED account's new leads attach to the account owner — territory rules apply ONLY to unowned accounts; first assignment records ownership
ownership.stale_owner: owner rep no longer in reps[] -> fall through to fresh territory assignment
ownership.buying_committee: committee_depth > 1 flags a buying team; all members inherit the same owner

account_grouping.$why_max: committee-best: sum rewards spam, avg lets an IT manager dilute a CRO
account_grouping.committee_depth: COUNT(leads) — tiebreaker/flag only, never score inflation

reps.name: Rep C — Public Sector, Retail & Commerce

fallback.$comment: unmatched account still routes — zero unrouted is a run invariant

$tie_break: first matching rep wins in match_order (a 'gov health system' routes to Rep B via 'health' only if no rep_a keyword hits first; order chosen so FinServ > Health/Ins > Public/Retail mirrors rubric vertical weights)
